name: pulseline
description: High-performance statusline and above-the-prompt activity band for Claude Code, with setup commands and diagnostics

binaryPath.title: cc-pulseline binary
binaryPath.description: Path to the cc-pulseline binary (1.7.0 or newer). Leave empty to look in the plugin's bin/, ~/.claude/pulseline/, PATH, and the repo's target/release.

desktopLayout.title: Desktop band layout
desktopLayout.description: The band's layout in the Claude Code desktop app, which runs no statusline: quiet (one thin strip of quota gauges, cost and $/h and the branch, plus a gauge and a /compact button when context passes 70%), compact (identity and budget above the activity row), or the powerline rail or anchor with the activity rows under the bar.
